note: A fixed bank of common interview questions, written by Steady Path Careers. None of these is attributed to any employer. Family keys match the career fields the intake form uses (assets/intake2.js FIELDS).
label: Common questions for this kind of role

general.q: Why do you want this job?
What do you know about our organization?
What is something you are working to get better at?
Why are you leaving, or why did you leave, your last job?
What pay are you looking for?
What questions do you have for us?

behavioral.q: Tell me about a time you solved a hard problem at work.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a coworker or a manager. What did you do?
Tell me about a mistake you made and how you handled it.
Tell me about a time you had too much to do. How did you decide what came first?
Tell me about a time you had to learn something quickly.
Tell me about a time you helped an unhappy customer, patient or client.
Tell me about a time you went past what your job asked of you.
Tell me about a time you worked with someone who was hard to work with.

questions.q: How do you explain a diagnosis or a treatment plan to a patient who is worried?
Tell me about a time you caught something that others had missed.
How do you keep your charting accurate on a busy day?
How do you handle a patient who does not want the treatment you recommend?
How do you stay current in your field?
How do you decide what to do first when several patients need you at once?
Tell me about a time you spoke up about a patient safety concern.
How do you hand off a patient at the end of a shift?
How do you work with a family member who is upset?
What do you do when you are not sure about an order?
Walk me through how you troubleshoot a problem you have not seen before.
How do you explain a technical problem to someone who is not technical?
Tell me about an outage or an urgent ticket you handled.
How do you keep track of your work and document what you changed?
What have you taught yourself lately, and how?
Walk me through how you close the books at month end, or the part you owned.
Tell me about a time you found an error in the numbers. What did you do?
How do you check your own work?
Which accounting or reporting software have you used, and for what?
How do you handle a deadline when you are waiting on someone else for information?
Walk me through a sale you are proud of, from first contact to close.
How do you handle a customer who says the price is too high?
How do you plan your week to reach your number?
Tell me about a deal or an account you lost. What did you learn?
How do you keep a customer after the sale?
How do you explain a coverage gap to a customer in plain words?
Which lines of business have you worked with, and which licenses do you hold?
Tell me about a hard claim or renewal conversation and how it ended.
How do you keep your files accurate and compliant?
How do you find coverage a customer needs but did not ask about?
How do you keep track of many requests from different people?
Which office software do you use most, and what do you do with it?
Tell me about a time you handled confidential information.
Tell me about a process you made simpler or faster.
How do you handle a visitor or caller who is upset?
Which tools, equipment or systems do you know best?
Tell me about a job where something went wrong on site. What did you do?
How do you keep yourself and your crew safe?
Which licenses or certifications do you hold?
How do you read a plan or a work order and decide where to start?
How do you manage a classroom or a group when attention drops?
Tell me about a student you helped who was struggling.
How do you work with parents or guardians?
How do you plan a lesson for students at different levels?
How do you know that students learned what you taught?
Tell me about a time you turned around a bad customer experience.
How do you stay friendly and accurate during a rush?
What days and hours can you work?
Have you handled cash, a register or closing duties? Tell me about it.
What would you do if you saw a coworker break a rule?
Which equipment are you trained or certified to operate?
How do you keep your counts and paperwork accurate?
Tell me about a time you noticed a safety problem. What did you do?
How do you handle a late load, a missed delivery window or a short shipment?
What shifts and schedules have you worked?
How do you keep track of deadlines across many matters?
Which practice areas and document types have you worked on?
Tell me about a time you caught an error before it went out.
How do you handle confidential or privileged material?
Which case management or research tools have you used?
